title: Relative pointed flag-curve data
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme and let $T,G$ be group objects in schemes over $S$, using the relative group-object diagrams of [def-sc-group-scheme], with a group homomorphism $i_T:T\to G$. Use fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product] and fppf coverings [def-pc-fppf-site]. A relative pointed flag curve for $(G,T,i_T)$ consists of a group scheme $B$ and a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] of group schemes $i:B\to G$ through which $i_T$ factors, such that $B\to S$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and every geometric fibre is connected [def-weil-connected-scheme]; a smooth proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] $S$-scheme $X$, a morphism $p:G\to X$, a left scheme action of $G$ on $X$, and a section $\sigma:S\to X$. The action satisfies $a(g,p(h))=p(gh)$ on every test scheme. The section is $p\circ e_G$ and is fixed by $B$. For every $S'\to S$, the pulled map $p_{S'}$ represents the fppf sheaf of right cosets $G_{S'}/B_{S'}$: for every $S'$-scheme $V$, $p_{S'}(g)=p_{S'}(h)$ if and only if $g^{-1}h$ lies in the image of $B_{S'}(V)$, and every section of $X_{S'}(V)$ lifts along $p_{S'}$ on an fppf covering of $V$. There is a pulled scheme action on $X_{S'}$ whose first-projection comparison with $a$ agrees on every pair of points, and the pulled identity section has first projection equal to $\sigma$. For every geometric point $t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ [def-weil-geometric-point], $X_\Omega$ is isomorphic over $\Omega$ to the projective line with two homogeneous coordinates [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. For every $\Omega$-scheme $V$, the action identifies $G_\Omega(V)$ with the group of all $V$-automorphisms of $X_\Omega\times_\Omega V$: there is a multiplicative equivalence whose value at $g$, after every further test scheme $W\to V$, acts on $x$ by $g|_W\cdot x$. This formula specifies the induced homomorphism and its naturality. All schemes and test objects have one common size universe; no smoothness, reductivity, splitness or rank condition on $G$ is part of this definition.

source.place: Conrad, Proposition 4.2.7, proof through the section of the genus-zero curve, printed pp.123--124; the geometric action is the standard action of PGL2 on its Borel quotient. Relative quotient representability and properness are Theorem 2.3.6, printed pp.72--75; the cocharacter parabolic construction is Section 4.1. Read online; WANTED locally as literature/conrad-reductive-group-schemes.pdf. No Stacks tag states this assertion in this form.
